name: 1.2.0 - Decision-gated workflow routing and skill harness hardening
body:
This release strengthens OSpec change execution with durable user decisions, workflow routing, staged debugging, worktree closeout choices, skill authoring checks, Checkpoint evidence gates, and publication safety scans.

## New

- Added session-start hook artifacts and using-ospec bootstrap context so AI harnesses can inject active-change guidance at the start of a session.
- Added durable user decision gates with structured options, recommendations, chat-ready prompts, decision indexes, and required-decision blocking for dispatch and finish readiness.
- Added brainstorm decision gates so direction, scope, and verification-risk choices can be recorded as durable required or optional user decisions before dispatch.
- Added workflow route artifacts that persist the next recommended OSpec command for human or AI handoff.
- Added staged debugging evidence phases for reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, fix, and verify discipline.
- Added worktree lifecycle planning and finish decision prompts for PR strategy, merge strategy, branch retention, and cleanup choices.
- Added OSpec-native skill authoring and local skill package checks.
- Added machine-readable launch adapter packets and JSON launch output for external harness adapters.
- Added native harness launch metadata for Cursor and Copilot.

## Improved

- Improved execute status, next, bootstrap, and finish output so pending decisions, Checkpoint evidence readiness, missing evidence, and next repair actions are visible without reading raw artifacts.
- Improved finish and worktree artifacts so closeout guidance keeps branch, PR, merge, retention, and cleanup decisions explicit.
- Improved debugging reports with phase snapshots so incomplete root-cause work is visible before verification.
- Improved orchestration fallback reports with failed-worker aggregation and retry commands.
- Improved parallel dispatch safety by detecting same-file and same-module worker conflicts.
- Improved Checkpoint doctor and gate output with routes.yaml and flows.yaml diagnostics, baseline setup guidance, screenshot, trace, visual diff, route, flow, assertion, console, network, and accessibility coverage counts.
- Improved generated AI guidance, packaged skills, project conventions, and public usage docs for decision-gated change execution.

## Fixed

- Fixed archive and verify readiness so Checkpoint cannot pass with incomplete runtime evidence for active Checkpoint steps.

## Docs

- Documented session hook to decision, dispatch, Checkpoint, and finish flow in public usage guides.
- Documented brainstorm decision gates, workflow routing, staged debugging, worktree lifecycle, finish decision prompts, and skill authoring checks.
- Documented Checkpoint evidence-gated plugin release checks.
- Added a release content scan to block external reference labels and local source-directory labels from publication files.

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g @clawplays/ospec-cli@1.2.0
ospec update
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/clawplays/ospec/compare/1.1.0...1.2.0
